nit cum Vsserio suo Archiepiscopo Arma-

esse contendit : Vsserius verò non propter
nullius momenti suspiciunculas, ut ait vir
quidam eruditus notis in hanc ipsam ad
ut putabat, ad id impulsus rationibus
lam unicam quæ ipsi cum Smyrnæis suis

page.notes: The printed "8.immò" shows a stray mark between the full stop and "immò" (possibly "8.imm.ò"); transcribed as "8.immò". The ligature for long s in "Vsserius" and "ss" forms is read as "ss". The page is a faint scan; the opening word "nianis" is a continuation from the previous page.
